promotion.scope: Development selection only; not independent future validation

protocol.selection: Pooled 2021–2023 log loss only; unchanged V2 promotion gate against baseline_v2
protocol.splits: Train before preceding July1; calibrate July–December; score next calendar year
protocol.confirmation: 2024 is retrospective, already inspected; never used for selection
protocol.blend: Equal uncalibrated symmetric baseline/challenger probabilities, then independent disjoint temperature calibration
protocol.weekly_rank: Additive complete dated media board inputs, latest strictly before date; stale after35days; unknown distinct from verified absence. Live observation eligible only after retrieval, never backfilled into development.
protocol.ranked_opposition: Last5 strictly prior bouts; opponent rank frozen before that bout from dated boards only. Unknown ranks excluded. Strength=(16-rank)/16 with champion0/unranked16. Two-observation priors: strength.5,top5share0,ranked-opponent decisive winshare.5. Known-rank share=known/covered count,zero with no bouts. Draw/NC excluded from winshare denominator.

study.retrospective_scope: Previously inspected year; baseline and selected only after selection lock; never a selection input or untouched holdout.
study.event_bootstrap: 2000 paired event resamples, seed42; upper95 log-loss difference below zero
study.all_novice: Both athletes have at most3 prior covered bouts; diagnostic only
study.prior_count_policy: All canonical covered bouts strictly before event day; same-date observations excluded.
study.immutable_outputs: Never replace an existing different artifact or study report; use versioned output directories.

evaluation.kind: Previously inspected year; baseline and selected only after selection lock; never a selection input or untouched holdout.

warnings: 2024 is an already-inspected retrospective comparison, not an untouched holdout.
Weekly rankings are retrospectively reconstructed; live observations are never backfilled into history.
Sparse histories and unusual hypothetical matchups limit direct validation; no requested probability is a training target.
